lines.text: Your strongest model should decide the architecture. It should not write the fortieth boilerplate test.
Leverage is an intelligence resource manager for MCP hosts. Your frontier model stays the strategist. Leverage hires the workforce underneath it.
Hard policy runs before scoring. A paid model under a zero dollar budget is not ranked lower. It is removed. Then an auction hires the best eligible worker for every task.
Cloud workers execute as RocketRide pipelines, through a permanent hosted pool. Credits are measured, not estimated.
When a worker hits a rate limit, Leverage checkpoints what it understood and hands it to a replacement. The work does not restart.
A model saying done is not proof. A task completes when a compiler or a test suite agrees.
Four of four tasks verified. Three handoffs. Zero dollars of paid inference. One frontier brain. An elastic workforce.
